title: Smells amazing
text: I love this body lotion, the scent lasts all day and my dry skin feels soft. Would buy again.

title: Arrived broken
text: The bottle arrived with the pump snapped and lotion leaked all over the box. Poor packaging.

title: Smaller than expected
text: Works fine but it is much smaller than the photos made it look. Not great value for the price.

title: Gave me a rash
text: After two days my face was red and itchy. Had to stop using it. Would not recommend.

title: Good for the price
text: Decent quality hair brush, bristles are soft. Worth it for under ten dollars.

title: Exactly as pictured
text: The shade matches the listing perfectly and it arrived well packed. Great purchase.
